scope: Independent per-sample media placement of PCM and 11 compressed codec mappings; six PCM rates, fine/signed/scaled clocks, gaps/overlap/negative clipping, late metadata, lacing/padding/delay, selected ordinals and ignored foreign clocks. Opus/AAC/AC3/EAC3 seeks use independently decoded packet suffixes; codec DSP is established separately. Guarded mutations are capped at 128 reads and seek at 64. This does not establish video/A/V synchronization or native Mac playback.
source_provenance: sources/runtime_sources retain exact tested working-file bytes; git_source_sha256 records canonical staged Git bytes. Differences were checked to consist only of CRLF/LF line endings.
